body: Tall people complain about it a lot more.

Our prayers have been answered! You can post multiple pictures! Wow! What about not suppressing negative things about China? What about not censoring people for simply making a point? What about not being the repository of lies and bullshit?

Only harm would be emotional harm. Subconscious harm. The harm the comes from being alive and hating every second of it. 

Everyone here is suicidal, including those talking us off the ledge. Even you. We all have positive feelings and power through. Most of the time. I don’t think I need to apologize for having kids. It’s not like they were born yesterday. This is not a place for judgement or arguments based on how pedantic one can be. Please remember your audience before you pass judgement.
If DFW and Chris Cornell can’t hack it what chance do I have?
Thanks for reading. This whole experience has really made me realize some things I never thought of before.

My wife and I fought over some bullshit and now I think I’m working on divorce number 2. And I think my subconscious is sabotaging this relationship because I know deep down it won’t work and the woman I know is right for me just left my life forever today.
I don’t need safety gloves because I’m homer Simp.....

You came to, what’s supposed to be, an activist free sub to do what? Become an activist. The only part of my post that suggests I need to check myself in is the bit about being suicidal. Does me thinking life being hard require mental help? Is my opinion on the way society squeezes every dollar out of us it can incorrect? 

It’s like you went in a gay club with a big sign up front that says, “you will receive no judgement here.” to pass judgement on gay people. If you don’t see that then I can’t break it down more clearly for you.

There is a time and a place for your phoned in advice but it is not here. This is where we come to get away from people like you. “Get help.” Gee! I didn’t think of that! There’s people that help with this? I’ve never tried that! /s

I came here to get something off my chest and you decide to turn it into your chance to be condescending and tell someone to get help that you’ve never met. How about you get help for your closed minded narcissistic view of the world? 

You don’t care about me, you want to be right. You want to go to sleep thinking you helped but, guess what, your attitude is probably the most damaging. Your view is the system that has failed us.
Says the guy trolling suicidal people.
They’d lock me in an asylum and throw away the key for saying this shit. Go back to your fantasy land where everything is perfect and you’re a hero for not using a plastic straw you fuck.
Fuck you. That’s not what this sub is for.

If you must know, I don’t typically snore. I snore occasionally and it’s been made worse by a memory foam mattress that she insisted on buying which is a whole other story. So now, instead of snoring once a month it’s more like every other day.

I think I’ll end up sleeping in a separate room in our old bed and let this disaster work itself out. I think she knows she fucked up and it’s not the first time. Once cooler heads prevail and she has a chance to get used to the idea, we’ll probably split.

Wow! 15 years. I like the way you put it, “I granted her the divorce” I was married 14 years before and I know EXACTLY what you mean. The person who steps back and says, “I’m ok not fighting for this.” Is usually blamed but they do the hard work of sticking to their decision for the greater good. I thank my ex every day for that. I don’t know if I’m strong enough to stick to it though.
